biotools.summary: PopPIPE is a pipeline for integrated population clustering and genomic epidemiology of bacterial genomes, combining reference-free genome analysis to split populations into subclusters and detect plausible transmission events. It provides a user-friendly and reproducible analysis spanning species-wide clustering to outbreak investigations.
